purpose: Text action control for primary, secondary, subtle, danger, and ghost actions.

guidance.useWhen: Use for primary business actions such as Save, Submit, Create, or Cancel.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for repeated icon-only utilities; use IconButton or ToolbarButton instead.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Use visible text for important actions.

limitations: Avoid for repeated icon-only utilities; use IconButton or ToolbarButton instead.

accessibility.notes: Button renders a native button and supports disabled/loading states.

examples.title: Variants
examples.intent: Compare the supported visual intents before choosing emphasis for an action.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.intent: Compare the supported size scale against the surrounding control density.

examples.title: Disabled and loading
examples.intent: Show unavailable and in-progress actions using the shared disabled and loading behavior contract.

examples.title: Full width
examples.intent: Show a prominent action expanding to the available inline space.

examples.title: Icons and labels
examples.intent: Compose visible labels with leading or trailing icon content without replacing important text.

examples.title: Form actions
examples.intent: Use explicit submit and reset button types when Button participates in a form workflow.
